faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIAHL Chairman & Managing Director recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the AIAHL Chairman & Managing Director post is 10th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum age requirement for the Chairman & Managing Director post?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for the Chairman & Managing Director post is 45 years.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Chairman & Managing Director position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Chairman & Managing Director position is 60 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Engineering Graduates, Chartered Accountants, Cost Accountants, Post Graduates, or Graduates with an MBA/PGDIM from a recognized institute.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any experience required for the Chairman & Managing Director role?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates need cumulative experience of at least 5 years in the last 10 years in specific fields like Finance, Business Development, Operations, etc.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Chairman & Managing Director post?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 180000 to Rs. 320000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the AIAHL Chairman & Managing Director job?
faq.answer: You can apply online through the official AIAHL website or the direct application link provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Chairman & Managing Director post?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Online Application, Shortlisting, and Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article.
